Thanks to GKMTec for sending the Neo-X1 Pro over for review. Like all reviews on the channel, no money changed hands, GMKTec gets no input in the production of this video, nor the opportunity to review prior to publishing. I forgot to include my standard disclaimer in the video, so you get it in text form.

Grab yourself a Pint Glass at https://craftcomputing.store

Support me on Patreon and get access to my exclusive Discord server. Chat with myself and the other hosts on Talking Heads all week long.

https://www.patreon.com/CraftComputing

Today we're taking a look at an all new Gaming SFF PC from GMKTec in the Neo-X1 Pro, a 14.6L chassis with a 16-Core AMD Zen 5 X3D CPU, NVIDIA RTX 5070 12GB and 64GB of memory inside. An absolute beast of a machine to be sure, but should you buy one in this economy?

But first... What am I drinking???

Silver Falls Coffee Co. Sumatra dark roast, french pressed.
